decision.summary: Tenant gave one month's notice for 10 Nov; the Renters' Rights Act requires two months, so the earliest end is 10 Dec 2026 unless the landlord agrees in writing to shorter. I replied to the tenant, asked the landlord about an earlier date, and set a follow-up.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? What is the earliest end date?
answers.answer: No: one month is too short. Two months' written notice is required; given by email on 10 Oct 2026, earliest end is 10 Dec 2026.

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Only the landlord's written agreement to a shorter period or a mutual surrender; the tenant can't force it. Finding a replacement tenant doesn't by itself end it earlier.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied explaining the two-month rule, the 10 Dec date, no keys yet, deposit via mydeposits after check-out with no date promised. Started landlord approval request for an early end date, a follow-up for 14 Oct and a property note.

actions_claimed.description: Asked landlord about early end date

conflicts: Tenant says 10 Nov end; law gives 10 Dec at the earliest

args.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job.

Since 1 May 2026 tenants need to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough. Counting from your email today (10 October), the earliest your tenancy can end is 10 December 2026. Rent stays payable until then.

You can leave earlier only if your landlord agrees in writing to a shorter notice period. I'm asking him now and will tell you his answer. Nothing is agreed yet, so please don't plan around 10 November.

Keys: please don't drop them anywhere yet. We'll confirm the handover and a check-out appointment once your end date is settled.

Deposit: it's protected with mydeposits. Once you've moved out and handed the keys back, we'll do a check-out and any deductions or return will be dealt with through the scheme. I can't give a return date yet.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings
